article.story: Arkansas (3-5) at Auburn (4-4), Nov. 7 at 12:45 p.m. EST. Opening Line: Auburn by 10.5. Against the spread: Auburn 2-6, Arkansas 3-5. How to watch: SEC Network Key stats Auburn Offense Overall: 368 yards per game (83rd in FBS) Passing: 215.4 yards per game (83rd) Rushing: 152.6 yards per game (73rd) Scoring: 24.1 points per game (93rd) Auburn Defense Overall: 408.1 yards per game (116th in FBS) Passing: 252.4 yards per game (122nd) Rushing: 155.8 yards per game (89th) Scoring: 26.8 points per game (94th) Arkansas Offense Overall: 336.1 yards per game (112th in FBS) Passing: 231.1 yards per game (65th) Rushing: 105 yards per game (131st) Scoring: 19.6 points per game (125th) Arkansas Defense Overall: 361.8 yards per game (71st in FBS) Passing: 208.8 yards per game (65th) Rushing: 153 yards per game (82nd) Scoring: 27.6 points per game (101st) Arkansas is 119th in defensive third down percentage, allowing opponents to convert 43.1% of the time. Auburn ranks 39th on offense, converting on 43.8% of third downs. Auburn ranks 133rd in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 96.2% of trips. Auburn ranks 132nd in the FBS with an average time of possession of 26:54, compared to Arkansas' 38th-ranked average of 31:24. Team leaders Auburn Passing: Byrum Brown, 1,557 yards, 9 TDs, 7 INTs, 64.2 completion percentage Rushing: Brown, 484 yards on 139 carries, 7 TDs Receiving: Keshaun Singleton, 433 yards on 39 catches, 2 TDs Arkansas Passing: K.J. Jackson, 1,673 yards, 7 TDs, 5 INTs, 60.6 completion percentage Rushing: Sutton Smith, 217 yards on 63 carries, 1 TD Receiving: Chris Marshall, 633 yards on 43 catches, 2 TDs Last game Auburn was defeated by Ole Miss 45-15 on Oct. 31. Brown threw for 195 yards on 25-of-38 attempts (65.8%) with one touchdown and no interceptions. He also carried the ball 13 times for 5 yards and one rushing touchdown. Jeremiah Cobb had 35 rushing yards on seven carries, adding one reception for -1 yards. DeShawn Spencer had four receptions for 62 yards. Arkansas fell to Missouri 34-10 on Oct. 31. Jackson passed for 229 yards on 20-of-34 attempts (58.8%) with no touchdowns and one interception. He also carried the ball 13 times for 33 yards and one rushing touchdown. Cam Settles had 38 rushing yards on 12 carries, adding four receptions for 25 yards. Antonio Jordan put up 106 yards on seven catches. Next game Auburn plays at Mississippi State on Nov. 14. Arkansas hosts No. 23 South Carolina on Nov. 14.
